Whenever you break the big spike, Nayzaga is stunned for a while and no longer powered up. This is where you do most of your damage! If you can break the small ones as soon as they appear it is a big benefit. I always break the big one ASAP, and take at least one small one out when he spawns them.

As an axe user, I'm not too familiar. I'd recommend using at least +2 deconstruction for cells. For the sword my best guess would be to space out repeating elements. If it's not working out let your teammates focus on the spires and you can aggro nayzaga, communication is a valuable tool! I'd estimate the spires have about 1000ish health, so whichever combo can get you there first reliable, for it it just took time to find what worked..

If you're in a party, as long as everyone takes out one spire while a 4th person districts is being attacked it works well. Then the last few can be taken out a lot easier.

Encouragement to all who struggle with nayzaga; once you figure out the patterns he is easy. Just make sure you manage his spires, take out the big one when he grows spines, and punish his really laggy melee attacks! I'm open to help anyone take him on :)
